settings.heading: Shipping & Pre-Order Policy
settings.body: Last updated: [DATE]. These are practical drafts — replace every bracketed field and have policies reviewed for your markets before launch.

settings.content:
Pre-order status

Products marked “Pre-Order” are not available for immediate shipment. By placing a pre-order, you reserve products from an upcoming production release.

Estimated shipping window

The current estimated shipping window is [DATE] to [DATE]. This is an estimate based on information available from our production and fulfillment partners and is not a guaranteed delivery date.

Payment

[We charge the full order amount at checkout / We charge a deposit of X at checkout and collect the remaining balance on fulfillment]. The payment timing will be displayed before you confirm your purchase.

Order updates

We will send updates to the email address used at checkout. Please ensure your contact information is accurate.

Delays

If we learn that we cannot ship within the stated window, we will notify you with a revised estimate and explain your option to continue waiting or cancel the unshipped order for a prompt full refund. Where the law requires affirmative consent to a delay, we will request it.

Address changes

Contact [EMAIL] as soon as possible. We cannot guarantee changes after an order enters fulfillment.

Split shipments

[State whether in-stock and pre-order products ship together or separately and whether extra charges apply].

Shipping rates and destinations

We currently ship to [COUNTRIES / REGIONS]. Rates and available services appear at checkout. Customers are responsible for providing a complete deliverable address.

Tracking

Tracking information will be emailed after shipment. Carrier scans can take [X] business days to appear.

International duties

[If applicable] Import duties, taxes, and fees are [customer/merchant] responsibility and are not included unless stated at checkout.

Contact

Questions about shipping or pre-orders can be sent to [SUPPORT EMAIL].
